// era-fields.js.txt — SCANNED, NEVER RUN. ONE FEATURE, and a file of its own.
//
// A FOURTH FILE rather than four more lines in era.js, for the reason the third
// one was split out: era.js is asserted to fail es2020 for EXACTLY ONE reason
// and that reason is an OPERATOR. Class fields are ES2022, so putting them
// there would have made that assertion two-valued and destroyed what it
// demonstrates. The `.txt` tail is load-bearing for the same reason it is on
// every fixture here.
//
// FIVE KINDS, ONE FEATURE: a public field, a private field, a private method,
// a private name and a static block are one edition's worth of class syntax and
// `kind_needs` gates all five on `class_fields`.
class Fielded {
  count = 0;
  #secret = 1;

  #reveal() {
    return this.#secret;
  }

  static {
    Fielded.registered = true;
  }

  read() {
    return this.count + this.#reveal();
  }
}

export const fielded = new Fielded();
